title: "Aciclovir - Zeng et al. 2009"

# Population Pharmacokinetics of Acyclovir in Children and Young People with Malignancy after Administration of Intravenous Acyclovir or Oral Valacyclovir (Zeng L, Nath CE, Blair EYL, Shaw PJ, Stephen K, Earl JW, Coakley JC, McLachlan AJ, Antimicrob Agents Chemother 2009)

Reference: doi:10.1128/AAC.01138-08 (Antimicrob Agents Chemother 2009;53(7):2918-2927; Table 3).

**Model type: parametric population pharmacokinetic model** (nonlinear mixed-effects, FOCE with interaction, NONMEM V). Suitable for simulation and MAP Bayesian estimation. Caution: the default serum creatinine is assumed (not reported) and the authors' simulations (Table 4) are not reproduced exactly (see Notes).

## Notes

- Study: prospective single-centre study (Sydney), 43 children and young people with malignancy aged 0.8-19.9 years (25 IV aciclovir only, 7 oral valaciclovir only, 11 both), 1,216 plasma concentrations (HPLC, LOQ 0.1 mg/L). Median (range) age 6.3 (0.8-19.9) years, weight 19.6 (7.3-70.2) kg, height 111.0 (69.0-173.5) cm, BSA 0.77 m2, Counahan CLCR 3.7 (2.0-5.7) L/h/m2; 25 males, 18 females (Table 1).
- The article models IV aciclovir and oral valaciclovir simultaneously. This file is the IV aciclovir version (infusion into the central compartment). The oral version is `pediatrie/valaciclovir_VO/models/parametric/VACV_Zeng.Rmd`, with identical disposition parameters, covariates, IIV and IOV on CL and V; the absorption parameters (ka, F) and their IIV are specific to the oral route and are not included here.
- Dose: `amt` in mg of aciclovir, 5 mg/kg three times daily as a 1-h infusion (`rate = amt / 1`).
- Structure: one-compartment model, first-order elimination (a two-compartment model was less stable and not retained).
- Covariates (final model): CL = 3.55 x (WT/19.6)^0.75 x (CLCR/3.7)^0.51; V = 7.36 x (WT/19.6). CLCR is the Counahan-Barratt estimate, CLCR (mL/min/1.73 m2) = 0.43 x HT (cm) / SCR (mg/dL), "standardized to the value per m2" and expressed in L/h/m2; it is computed in the model (SCR in umol/L divided by 88.4) and captured in both units.
- **Ambiguity:** the conversion from mL/min/1.73 m2 to L/h/m2 is not detailed. **Choice:** CLCR (L/h/m2) = CLCR (mL/min/1.73 m2) x 0.06 / 1.73; the reported range 2.0-5.7 L/h/m2 then corresponds to 58-164 mL/min/1.73 m2, plausible for this population (without division by 1.73 it would be 33-95 mL/min/1.73 m2).
- **Ambiguity:** the median serum creatinine is not reported. **Choice:** SCR = 40 umol/L, which with the median height (111 cm) gives CLCR 3.7 L/h/m2, the reference value. Default covariates: WT 19.6 kg, HT 111 cm, SCR 40 umol/L.
- IIV (Table 3, CV%): CL 23.6%, V 35.9%, converted with omega^2 = ln(1 + CV^2): 0.0542 and 0.1211.
- IOV (Table 3, CV%): CL 19.2%, V 30.4% (omega^2 0.0362 and 0.0883), occasions of 7 days; implemented with two paired occasions (covariate OCC).
- Residual error: Y = IPRED x exp(eps1) + eps2, approximated by a combined proportional/additive error. **Ambiguity:** sigma1 = 0.26 and sigma2 = 0.1 are not stated as SDs or variances. **Choice:** SDs (proportional CV 26%, additive SD 0.1 mg/L), i.e. variances 0.0676 and 0.01.
- Targets used by the authors: time above IC50 (0.56 mg/L for HSV, 1.125 mg/L for VZV) > 12 h per 24 h ("maximal efficacy").
- Simulation check against Table 4 (Monte Carlo, 1,000 patients per scenario with the published IIV and IOV, 5 mg/kg every 8 h, 1-h infusion, steady state): median time above 0.56 / 1.125 mg/L per 24 h of 23.7 / 18.9 h, 17.1 / 13.5 h and 15.0 / 11.7 h for a 10 kg child with CLCR 2.0, 4.0 and 5.5 L/h/m2 (article: 21.8 / 16.4, 15.2 / 11.5 and 12.9 / 9.8 h), 21.6 / 17.1 h for 25 kg and 24.0 / 19.8 h for 50 kg at CLCR 4.0 (article 19.2 / 14.5 and 22.8 / 17.2 h); percentage of 10 kg children with more than 12 h above 0.56 mg/L 96, 82 and 71% (article 81.5, 64.7 and 54.0%). The trends with weight and CLCR are reproduced, but the simulated times are about 2 h longer in all 9 scenarios.
- **Ambiguity:** Table 4 is not reproduced exactly with the Table 3 estimates. The 9 typical medians are reproduced within 1.2 h (VZV within 0.4 h) only if CL is multiplied by 1.17 (or V by 0.78), which matches no documented alternative (the CLCR and weight equations are explicit in the Methods; bolus or 2-h infusions, residual error and IOV do not explain the difference). The 5th percentiles of Table 4 (7.2, 5.1 and 4.3 h for 10 kg) are much lower than those simulated with the published variability (12.9, 9.3 and 8.4 h) and are close to those obtained when the reported CVs are used directly as variances (7.2, 5.7 and 4.8 h), suggesting that the authors' simulation settings differed from Table 3. **Choice:** the Table 3 estimates and the omega^2 = ln(1 + CV^2) conversion are kept; exposures may be about 15% higher than in the authors' simulations.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(mrgsolve)
library(mapbayr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r model}
code <- '
[PROB]
Zeng et al. 2009 - intravenous aciclovir in children and young people with malignancy
(43 patients, 1,216 samples after IV aciclovir and oral valaciclovir, NONMEM V FOCE-I). One-compartment model,
IV infusion into the central compartment. Covariates: weight (allometry) and Counahan CLCR (computed from HT and SCR, power) on CL,
weight on V. IIV and IOV (two occasions) on CL and V. Combined residual error.

[SET] end = 24, delta = 0.1

[PARAM] @annotated
TVCL     : 3.55 : Clearance for 19.6 kg and CLCR 3.7 L/h/m2 (L/h)
TH_CLCR  : 0.51 : Exponent of CLCR on CL (renal function factor)
CLCR_REF : 3.7  : Reference CLCR, median (L/h/m2)
WT_REF   : 19.6 : Reference weight, median (kg)
TVV      : 7.36 : Volume of distribution for 19.6 kg (L)
ETA1     : 0    : IIV CL
ETA2     : 0    : IIV V
ETA3     : 0    : IOV CL, occasion 1
ETA4     : 0    : IOV CL, occasion 2
ETA5     : 0    : IOV V, occasion 1
ETA6     : 0    : IOV V, occasion 2

[PARAM] @annotated @covariates
WT  : 19.6 : Body weight (kg)
HT  : 111  : Height (cm)
SCR : 40   : Serum creatinine (umol/L) (ambiguous, see Notes)
OCC : 1    : Occasion (1 or 2)

[CMT] @annotated
CENT : Central compartment, aciclovir (mg) [ADM, OBS]

[MAIN]
double CLCR_N = 0.43 * HT / (SCR / 88.4);
double CLCR = CLCR_N * 0.06 / 1.73;
double IOVCL = (OCC == 2) ? (ETA4 + ETA(4)) : (ETA3 + ETA(3));
double IOVV  = (OCC == 2) ? (ETA6 + ETA(6)) : (ETA5 + ETA(5));
double CL = TVCL * pow(WT / WT_REF, 0.75) * pow(CLCR / CLCR_REF, TH_CLCR) * exp(ETA1 + ETA(1) + IOVCL);
double V  = TVV * (WT / WT_REF) * exp(ETA2 + ETA(2) + IOVV);

[ODE]
dxdt_CENT = -CL / V * CENT;

[OMEGA] @annotated
ECL : 0.0542 : IIV CL (variance, CV 23.6%)
EV  : 0.1211 : IIV V (variance, CV 35.9%)

[OMEGA] @annotated
EOCL1 : 0.0362 : IOV CL occasion 1 (variance, CV 19.2%)
EOCL2 : 0.0362 : IOV CL occasion 2 (variance, CV 19.2%)
EOV1  : 0.0883 : IOV V occasion 1 (variance, CV 30.4%)
EOV2  : 0.0883 : IOV V occasion 2 (variance, CV 30.4%)

[SIGMA] @annotated
PROP : 0.0676 : Proportional error (variance, SD 0.26) (ambiguous, see Notes)
ADD  : 0.01   : Additive error (variance, SD 0.1 mg/L) (ambiguous, see Notes)

[TABLE]
double IPRED = CENT / V;
double DV = IPRED * (1 + EPS(1)) + EPS(2);
int i = 0;
while (DV < 0 && i < 100) { simeps(); DV = IPRED * (1 + EPS(1)) + EPS(2); ++i; }

[CAPTURE] @annotated
DV     : Aciclovir plasma concentration (mg/L)
CLCR_N : Creatinine clearance, Counahan (mL/min/1.73 m2)
CLCR   : Creatinine clearance, Counahan (L/h/m2)
CL     : Individual clearance (L/h)
V      : Individual volume of distribution (L)
'
mod <- mcode("ACV_Zeng", code)
```

```{r simulation}
# Authors' simulation scenarios (Table 4): 5 mg/kg three times daily (1-h infusion), weights 10, 25 and 50 kg,
# CLCR 2.0, 4.0 and 5.5 L/h/m2 (HT 111 cm; SCR computed to give each CLCR), steady state
data <- expand.grid(WT = c(10, 25, 50), CLCR = c(2.0, 4.0, 5.5)) %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number(), time = 0, evid = 1, cmt = 1, amt = 5 * WT, rate = amt / 1, ii = 8, addl = 11,
         HT = 111, SCR = 0.43 * HT / (CLCR * 1.73 / 0.06) * 88.4) %>%
  select(-CLCR)

out <- mod %>%
  zero_re() %>%
  data_set(data) %>%
  mrgsim(end = 96, delta = 0.05, carry_out = "WT") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(time >= 72)

# Time above IC50 over 24 h at steady state (article, Table 4, medians of 1,000 simulated patients:
# HSV 21.8 / 15.2 / 12.9 h and VZV 16.4 / 11.5 / 9.8 h for 10 kg and CLCR 2.0 / 4.0 / 5.5 L/h/m2)
out %>% group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(WT = WT[1], CLCR = round(CLCR[1], 1), CL = CL[1], V = V[1], Cmax = max(DV), Cmin = min(DV[time > 72]),
            T_HSV = 0.05 * sum(DV[time > 72] > 0.56), T_VZV = 0.05 * sum(DV[time > 72] > 1.125))

ggplot(out %>% filter(CLCR > 3.9 & CLCR < 4.1), aes(time - 72, DV, colour = factor(WT))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.56, 1.125), linetype = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Time (h)", y = "Aciclovir concentration (mg/L)", colour = "Weight (kg)",
       title = "Zeng et al. 2009 - 5 mg/kg IV every 8 h, CLCR 4.0 L/h/m2, steady state")
```
